rules.description: Inlet velocity range inside the validated envelope of this calculator. Outside it the design is blocked.

rules.description: Body diameter range inside the validated envelope of this calculator.

rules.description: Gas flow range inside the validated envelope of this calculator.

rules.description: Constant K in the Shepherd-Lapple pressure drop model: head number = K * a * b / De^2, pressure drop = head number * 0.5 * gas density * inlet velocity^2.
rules.sourceReference: Shepherd and Lapple (1939) tangential inlet cyclone pressure drop correlation, as given in Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook

rules.description: Number of effective gas turns Ne used in the Lapple cut diameter estimate. The estimate is indicative only.
rules.sourceReference: Lapple (1951) cut diameter model, commonly Ne about 5 for standard cyclones; Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook

rules.description: Wall thickness as a fraction of body diameter when the user does not supply one.
